full_judgment:
Sultan Hossain Khan, J.:- This appeal at the instance of shipowner and his agent is directed against the judgment and decree passed in a suit for recovery of money on account of non-delivery of 26 skids of Electrolytic tin plates. 

 4. The port trust also filed a written statement. They contended that 26 skids in suit were not landed from the vessel and the out turn report of the ship revealed that 20 skids out of the consignment of the plaintiff did not land at the port. They further contended that the manifested cargo or cargo under nil/wrong mark of the ship were removed to Saltgola godown of the customs and the port trust authority had no concern or liability with respect to the goods of the plaintiff. The insurance company also filed a written statement and denied their liability. The learned Subordinate Judge after framing necessary issue and on consideration of the evidence on record decreed the suit in part for a sum of Rs. 46,827/-. The learned Subordinate Judge held that though the defendant No. 1 and 2 informed the plaintiff that 16 skids out of 26 skids had been landed under wrong/nil mark and lying in Customs Godown, but those goods could not be connected with plaintiff's consignment by the customs authority. The learned Subordinate Judge has observed that though the 16 skids were pointed out by the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 as the goods of the plaintiff, there is no cogent evidence from the side of these defendants to show that the customs authority has connected these skids with the consignment of the plaintiff or the skids in fact correspond with the consignment of the' plaintiff. The learned Subordinate Judge on the basis of a survey report, Ext. 12 at the instance of the defendant Nov 3 however held that 3 skids tallied with plaintiff's consignment but the contents thereof were damaged and became scrap. Hence he deducted from the claim of the plaintiff a sum of Taka 1388/- being the salvage value of the content of the skids. This appeal is directed against the learned Subordinate Judge. 

 13. For the reasons stated herein above this appeal succeeds in part and the judgment and decree by the learned Subordinate Judge are modified and the suit is decreed for Rs. 42,664/-. The decrial dues shall bear interest at the rate of 6% per annum till recovery as has been allowed by the learned Subordinate Judge.
